name: Re-assessing previous applications
description: Guidelines and procedures for re-assessing previous applications for financial assistance, including determining whether an application has been made, outcomes of investigations, commencement dates for main benefits, backdating, correction power procedures, delegated authority levels, and review rights.

attributes.summary: Covers the policy and procedural framework for re-assessing expired or previous applications for financial assistance, including correction power cases, approval and decline procedures, and review rights.
